headlines.title: Adam Schiff says Democrats should put 'overriding emphasis' on costs, not impeachment
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) says Democratic oversight should focus on bringing down costs and corruption, that could potentially lead to impeachment.

headlines.title: Gretchen Whitmer says Republicans ‘don’t have a plan’ to lower costs: Full interview
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Gov. Gretchen Whitmer (D-Mich.) shares why she’s confident Democrats can win up and down the ballot in Michigan.

headlines.title: Mike Rogers on Trump calling Abdul El-Sayed a terrorist: ‘I've never called him a terrorist’
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Michigan Senate candidate and former Rep. Mike Rogers (R) responds to President Trump calling Abdul El-Sayed a “jihadist” and “violent terrorist.”

headlines.title: All-out fight for critical battleground states ramps up
headlines.description: Former President Barack Obama appeared in Ohio Saturday at his first campaign rally for this fall’s midterm elections, hoping to drum up support for Democratic candidates in key battleground races. It comes as the president cast his early ballot on Saturday in Florida. NBC News’ Shaquille Brewster reports from battleground Michigan where the former president rallies this evening.

headlines.title: Mary Peltola delays campaign events after sustaining ‘minor injuries’ in car crash
headlines.description: Anchorage police confirmed a crash involving three vehicles occurred Saturday and said those involved sustained “non-life threatening” injuries.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: How Democrats could win the House, how the GOP could hang on, and where to look for a wave
headlines.description: Three 2026 election scenarios that show which party could end up in control of the U.S. House of Representatives.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Woman sexually assaulted at knifepoint in Central Park, police say
headlines.description: A woman was sexually assaulted at knifepoint in Central Park over the weekend, police said.

headlines.title: Elvis Presley’s rights holders sue Anthropic saying it trained AI on his music
headlines.description: The owners of Elvis Presley’s music have sued Anthropic for allegedly using his copyrighted lyrics without permission to train its AI models and generating infringing versions of his songs.
